I am a real beginner for "lavaan" and more generally for SEM.

I would like to estimate the mediation effects of mediating variables (or indirect effects). So, I would like to implement mediation models.

I have a panel data. So, I will use fixed effect regressions for panel data (for example the plm function in the plm package) to define the relationships between the variables within the mediation models . With best regards,
